$comment: Policy of scripts/license-gate.mjs (npm run license:check) for every package the production dependencies reach; devDependencies are build and test tooling and never ship. SPDX identifiers, compared without regard to case. 'allowed' lists permissive licenses (OFL-1.1 for the bundled font). 'forbidden' and 'forbiddenPatterns' name strong and weak copyleft, non-commercial, no-derivatives and source-available licenses, which fail with a clear reason; any other license is unknown and fails too until someone reviews it and adds it here. 'packages' records a reviewed fact for one release whose metadata carries no usable license: key 'name@version', value { license, evidence }, where evidence links to the license text of exactly that release. 'notShipped' names packages the production tree reaches but the browser build never bundles, with the reason; the gate skips them and scripts/build.mjs fails if one of them is bundled after all.

sharp.reason: Node-only image backend of @huggingface/transformers (LGPL libvips binaries). The browser build resolves the package's web entry (dist/transformers.web.js), which does not import it.
